author: ETA PRIME
description:
C game emulation on Android has hit a whole new level. In this video I’m running real PC games on ARM devices using x86 emulation — no cloud gaming, no streaming. Testing Gamehub and Game Native on the Red magic 11 Pro, AYAN Odin 3 and the Legion Y700 Gen 4!
Over the last few months, getting your Steam library running on Android has gotten shockingly simple, and the performance from these newer Snapdragon chips is getting wild. I’m testing a few of my favorite games across multiple devices and apps, showing what works, what doesn’t, and the real-world FPS you can expect right now.
